inputs.prompt:
One continuous 15-second cinematic shot in a photorealistic ancient Chinese wuxia film. Begin exactly from the supplied first frame. Preserve the same adult swordswoman's identity, facial features, hairstyle, dark teal robe, silver bracers, sword, rainy night, old stone bridge, and lantern-lit ancient town throughout.

Timeline:
[0-3s] Medium close shot. The camera makes a very slow push forward. She keeps looking back over her shoulder. Rain beads and runs from her hair and silver bracer; warm lanterns sway gently in the wind.
[3-8s] She hears movement behind her. Her eyes shift toward the far end of the bridge, her right hand slowly closes around the sword hilt, and she lowers her center of gravity. The camera performs a subtle continuous arc to her left while keeping her face sharp and recognizable.
[8-12s] In one clean natural motion she turns and draws the sword. The blade cuts through the rain and throws real water droplets, with no magical glow. The camera tracks sideways half a step, maintaining cinematic stability and correct anatomy.
[12-15s] She settles into a guarded defensive stance, breathing steadily. Her robe hem and ponytail move in the wind and rain. Distant lanterns remain softly defocused as the camera gently comes to rest.

Single continuous take, no cuts, no transitions, no time jumps, no slow motion, no added people, no dialogue, no subtitles, no text, no logos, no watermark, no costume change. Natural realistic body motion, stable hands and sword, consistent face and identity.

Audio: continuous close rain, distant wind through the old town, one soft footstep on wet stone, cloth movement, and a crisp metallic sword-draw sound. No dialogue and no music.
